displayName: Sample: TRUMPF TruMatic of the TRUMPF OPC UA simulator, definition K09

elements.evidence: TRUMPF interface, Machine/EnergyMetering/InstantaneousValues/Power/PowerTotal. The node has no EngineeringUnits; the simulator documents kilowatt; times 1000. Unclear until a person confirms the unit of the real meter.

TRUMPF interface, Machine/EnergyMetering/MeterReadings/Energy/ReceivedEnergy. The node has no EngineeringUnits; the simulator documents kilowatt hours; times 1000 for wattHour, the unit of the catalogue of the data model. Unclear until a person confirms the unit of the real meter.
TRUMPF interface, ActivityMeters/DrivesOnTime, hours. The data model has no such element, so it is a value of the maker.

discovery.by: The simulator 1.4.0-alpha3 serves the machine in urn:umati2:datamodel:opcua, which the adapter maps itself: identification, state, feed override and power-on duration. Active program, energy and the drive time come from the TRUMPF interface and the MachineTool instance, as in the sample of definition L26.
